title: Lazy Propagation and What Composes
subtitle: CS253 / MA253 - Project 7 - Team MemoizedMinds
body: One million readings. Bulk corrections x -> a*x+b.
Structure A: lazy segment tree
Structure B: square-root decomposition
Oracle: independent plain array

title: One interface, two arithmetic modes
subtitle: Architect - Bhuvaneesh - D3
body: Zero-based half-open ranges [l,r); empty ranges are valid.
EXACT: a in {-1,0,1}; int64 extrema; sum modulo P.
MODULAR: arbitrary int64 a,b; sum modulo 998244353; extrema NA.
build / update / query / counters / check_invariants
Aggregates already include the node or block's pending tag.

title: Tags compose in a fixed order
subtitle: Structure B owner - Harshal - D2
body: Old f(x)=a1*x+b1, then new g(x)=a2*x+b2
compose(g,f) = (a2*a1, a2*b1+b2)
Sum: S' = a*S+b*L (mod P)
Negative gain: min'=-old_max+b; max'=-old_min+b
Add 3 then negate: -x-3. Reverse order: -x+3.

title: Stop at full cover, push at the boundary
subtitle: Structure A owner - Naresh - D1
body: A node includes its own tag; its children may lag.
Push applies the parent tag after each child's older tag.
Full cover stops; partial updates push, descend, then pull.
Build/space O(n). Range operations O(log n).

title: Tag whole blocks; scan only the ends
subtitle: Structure B owner - Harshal - D2
body: Full block: map aggregates and compose the tag in O(1).
Partial update: push the block tag, update raw values, then rebuild.
Partial query: map each covered raw value and combine its answer.
O(n/b+b) worst case. b=ceil(sqrt(n)); short last block uses its length.

title: An independent array checks the answers
subtitle: Oracle owner - Arush - D4
body: Production differential test: 1000000 operations per mode on 128 values.
EXACT seed 253; MODULAR seed 42. Failing cases are shrunk.
D5: 240 small independent-array cases plus exact counter checks.
Expanded CTest suite: 20/20 passed.
30 evaluator/reference cases; 12 malformed-input rejections passed.

title: Inputs constructed to expose failures
subtitle: Adversary - Anagh Singla, 250001006 - D5
body: push_downs: whole reset, then a deepest two-boundary probe.
alternating_negative_gain: inspect extrema before negations can cancel.
block_friendly: one aligned block; zero partial elements in B.
range_width_sweep: points to whole-array widths and several alignments.
For n=2^h: 2*h-1 pushes/probe; n=1000000: exact maximum 39.

title: Full-scale D5 verification is executed
subtitle: All four targets, both modes - seed 253
body: Each case: 1000000 elements and 1000000 operations.
Every A/B query agrees; final invariant audits pass.
Primed push queries also match an independent uniform-array formula.
500000 push probes -> 19500000 pushes.
Block-friendly: 1000000 full blocks, 0 partial elements.
These are correctness counts, not five-run timings.

title: Modulo needs more than a lazy sum tag
subtitle: Architect - Bhuvaneesh - D3
body: [1,5] and [3,3] have the same sum 6 and length 2.
Modulo 4 changes their sums to 2 and 6: summary information is insufficient.
Modulo-only variant: skip nodes with max<k; recurse otherwise.
A value that changes becomes less than half its previous value.
With point assignments: O((n+m)*log(n)*log(C)) total.
The modulo-only variant is a derivation, not a calibration command.

title: Full-scale means bracket two changes
subtitle: Analyst - Ranveer - D6 | Published campaign, before PR #31
body: n=q=1000000; seed 253; five trials per structure and width.
A wins at width 1; B wins at 64; A regains the lower mean at 1000.
Crossover brackets: 1..64 and 64..1000; nearby trials still needed.

title: Cost model: calibrated after measurement
subtitle: Analyst - Ranveer - D6 | Fit of the published campaign
body: A: node visits + pushes. B: full blocks + element scans.
Dashed curves fit these same means; they are not independent predictions.
Full width: A visits 1M roots; B accesses 1B full blocks.
